notes: Suppression Designer fixes: the selected manufacturer (Kidde/Badger/Buckeye/Amerex) now persists correctly when you save a project, close the app, and reopen it — it was always resetting to Kidde before, which made the export show the wrong system/nozzle info. Project Info now has separate Street Address and City/Province fields instead of one free-text Location box, so long addresses always break onto a predictable second line on the export instead of overlapping other text.
